title: Can We Still Trust American Air Travel?
summary: The FAA grounded every departing flight in the U.S. on Friday, only the second nationwide ground stop since 9/11. CBS News senior transportation correspondent Kris Van Cleave on why anyone would swap out equipment at 4 p.m. on a Friday, what doesn't add up in the official story, and why he's still flying.
